datasheet.label: Motivation
datasheet.value: A small offline fixture for developing the evaluation harness before a real corpus is connected.

datasheet.label: Composition
datasheet.value: Twelve glossary notes and eight questions about retrieval, generation and evaluation.

datasheet.label: Collection
datasheet.value: The notes were written for this repository; no third-party text is included.

datasheet.label: Intended use
datasheet.value: Smoke tests, UI development and metric sanity checks. Not a benchmark: the sample is too small for comparative claims.
